title: About GallarDesign
description: GallarDesign is a one-person web design studio. Every site is designed by a person, and AI makes the build fast.
heading: A designer, not a site factory
intro: GallarDesign is a one-person studio run by Glen Gallarde. Glen designs every site, talks to every client and answers every change request.
paragraphs: Small businesses are being offered two kinds of website. One is cheap and assembled by a bot in minutes. The other is designed properly but costs thousands upfront and takes months. GallarDesign sits in between: a real designer leads every site, and AI handles the repetitive build work, so the site is live in 14 days and priced like a monthly bill.
You deal with one person from the first call to launch and after. There's no account manager in the middle, so changes are done within two business days.

The terms are written to be fair. You own your content and domain from day one, and the site after the first year. If it isn't working out, there's a full refund in the first 30 days and a clear buyout price after that.
GallarDesign also works white label for agencies, building sites that go out under the agency's name.
